Chapter 01 · 18+

The Things
We Never Said

Bangkok. Rattanakosin International University. Two fourth-years, Jingjai and Sanit, best friends for four years who’ve done everything except say the one thing.

You’ve found what they left behind: two diaries, two phones, a camera roll. Read both sides. Tap the underlined bits to keep them as clues, then lay the same day from each diary next to each other. Somewhere in the gap is the truth.

Adult story with swearing and mature themes. Progress saves on this device. A special 18+ chapter might be coming. Vote at the end.
